description: FinsROV mechanical assembly referencing reusable library servos, thrusters, sensors, brackets, enclosure portions and individually fabricated details.
releaseRequirements: Resolve every source BOM versus CAD discrepancy shown in the assembly assessment before release.
Manufacture only the parts explicitly assigned a making route. Thrusters, servos, sensors, enclosure and their internal components are purchased equipment.
Complete omitted fasteners, sealing parts, internal supports, electronics and cabling from the upstream BOM and instructions.
Verify actual mating interfaces, thread engagement, sealing fits, buoyancy and electrical integration for the completed build.
